title: Anthony Gose's team, the Omaha Storm Chasers, beat the Salt Lake Bees 9-8 on Tuesday, July 21
text:
Anthony Gose’s team, the Omaha Storm Chasers, beat the Salt Lake Bees 9-8 on Tuesday, July 21
On Tuesday, July 21, at 8:35 p.m., former Bellflower Middle/High School standout Anthony Gose's current team, the Omaha Storm Chasers, defeated the Salt Lake Bees 9-8 in a MiLB game.
The game took place at The Ballpark at America First Square. It was the teams' first meeting this season.
Gose pitched 1.1 innings, gave up 2 hits, allowed 2 earned runs, walked 1 batter, struck out 1 batter and surrendered 1 home run.
The Storm Chasers' next game is scheduled for Wednesday, July 22, at The Ballpark at America First Square against the Bees.
Anthony Gose — Pitcher — 6′0″ — 200 — Hometown: Bellflower
